laws.rule: BIOT is not a tourist destination: entry needs prior permission, Diego Garcia is for authorised official duty only, and yachts may moor in the Outer Islands only for safe passage with a permit (GBP 250 a week, up to 28 days, apply 6 weeks ahead). Since 31 March 2026 new permit applications are paused except in exceptional circumstances. Entering without permission can bring imprisonment.

Strict Nature Reserves may not be approached within 3 nautical miles; diving, spear-fishing, removing plants or animals and commercial activity are prohibited, and fishing is allowed only by hand line for your own consumption.
